ask: Use Claude Code as an agent inside editors that speak Agent Client Protocol.
plugin: Ship an MCP/ACP bridge executable that proxies editor context, tool calls, and session events to Claude Code.

ask: Connect Claude Code to editors and IDE forks beyond the built-in list.
plugin: Package an MCP editor bridge and LSP adapters for Neovim, Emacs, Visual Studio, Eclipse, Zed, Positron, Obsidian, and VS Code forks.

ask: Read and edit source that lives in virtual or remote editor filesystems.
plugin: Expose an MCP filesystem tool backed by the editor provider, with URI-aware paths and write notifications; use function hooks to route tool calls there.

ask: Give Claude semantic symbol search, references, and safe refactoring across projects.
plugin: Bundle language servers and MCP symbol tools, selecting the project language server and returning precise locations and rename edits.

ask: Deliver current compiler and editor diagnostics to Claude after edits.
plugin: Expose diagnostics through an MCP/LSP server and a PostToolUse hook that fetches fresh project results; normalize diagnostic codes and build settings.

ask: Invoke Claude from editor quick-fix and inline editing commands.
plugin: Provide a registered command plus MCP editor range tool that applies a suggested patch to the selected range.

ask: Let Claude inspect and test a browser tab opened from an IDE.
plugin: Expose consented browser tabs, screenshots, and actions through an MCP server with a command to attach the active tab.

ask: Use notebook cells and kernels as first-class Claude context and tools.
plugin: Provide an MCP notebook server for cell IDs, execution, output, and refresh, plus a selection hook for the active cell.

ask: Choose when the active file or selection is sent to the model.
plugin: Use prompt.attachment and prompt.context function hooks to drop automatic IDE context until the user explicitly toggles it, with a UI indicator.

ask: Attach a chosen editor selection or open-file set to a prompt or skill.
plugin: Register an MCP editor-context tool and a command that captures selected ranges, notebook cells, open editors, or terminal selection on demand.

ask: Start and resume Claude in the intended workspace folder or worktree.
plugin: A command resolves the active editor folder and launches/resumes the matching session; function hooks guard cwd and per-session project routing.

ask: Find and attach files from all workspace roots and related repositories.
plugin: Provide an MCP file index and command picker that ranks the active editor and open files, understands ignored files and paths outside the root.

ask: Open cited files and symbols in the right editor at the right line.
plugin: Register an MCP OpenFile tool and a URI-aware bin command that resolves workspace roots, paths, line numbers, and external editors.

ask: Review all proposed changes together, with per-file or per-hunk decisions.
plugin: A PostToolUse/Stop hook records patches and opens an external or mounted review UI; approved hunks apply through a bin executable.

ask: Preserve user edits made during Claude diff review and concurrent agents.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook compares file revisions and merges or blocks stale writes; a PostToolUse hook reports the final patch back to Claude.

ask: Comment on a proposed plan or markdown file and send those comments back to Claude.
plugin: A command opens a reviewable plan document, records inline comments, and submits them through a prompt hook.

ask: Give sessions user-controlled or automatic names that stay stable across surfaces.
plugin: Use session hooks and a command to persist custom titles, auto-name them on demand, and suppress unwanted automatic renames; a mounted session view shows them.

ask: Find, organize, archive, pin, and recover local conversations across projects.
plugin: A bin indexer reads session transcripts and a mounted UI/command offers search, project grouping, pinning, archival, export, and recovery snapshots.

ask: Fork or rewind a session from a chosen turn in any client.
plugin: Register a command backed by session fork/rewind capabilities; save a branch point and open the new session in a mounted view.

ask: Create and route multiple independent Claude sessions and chat tabs.
plugin: A command launches sessions with distinct cwd and IDs; function hooks keep editor context and notifications tied to the owning session.

ask: Queue follow-up prompts without interrupting an active turn.
plugin: Use prompt and session event hooks to store per-session queued messages and submit each after turn.complete.

ask: Keep unfinished prompt text when changing chats or handling interruptions.
plugin: Use prompt.edit and UI hooks to persist drafts per session and restore them after navigation or question dialogs.

ask: See agent, tool, and session activity in one live view.
plugin: Use SessionStart, SubagentStart/Stop, and tool hooks to feed a monitor and mounted dashboard with per-agent timelines.

ask: Notify when a task completes, permission is needed, or a session needs attention.
plugin: A Notification/Stop hook sends native editor or system notifications and routes clicks to the owning session.

ask: Show context use, model, effort, elapsed time, and cost during a session.
plugin: A statusline or function-hook UI component reads session.usage and session.model, with a monitor for history and thresholds.

ask: Select model and effort per task or session and keep the intended setting.
plugin: Use turn.step and config hooks to choose model/effort per turn or session and expose a command for temporary overrides.

ask: Warn about context pressure and control when compaction is accepted.
plugin: Use session.measure and session.compact hooks to warn at a chosen threshold and replace or defer compaction when Claude Code requests it.

ask: Make plugin hooks visible and effective across native and IDE sessions.
plugin: A function-hook module observes prompt, tool, and session events and mirrors hook messages through UI notices when the client omits them.

ask: Run the same custom slash commands and skills from IDE and terminal views.
plugin: Register namespaced commands with command.run/describe function hooks and expose a searchable command palette for clients missing entries.

ask: Use the same MCP servers and tools in IDE sessions as in the CLI.
plugin: Package a plugin MCP configuration and function-hook tool registration that discovers servers consistently, including transport and path normalization.

ask: Apply explicit approval rules and show the exact command being authorized.
plugin: A PreToolUse/tool.check hook evaluates configured allowlists and displays precise tool arguments in a confirmation notice.

ask: Stream and manage shell output, background jobs, and process status.
plugin: A process.spawn function hook and monitor stream bounded output to a session panel and track owned process IDs.

ask: Launch Claude with the intended shell, PATH, config directory, and terminal profile.
plugin: A bin launcher and SessionStart hook resolve editor environment, cwd, shell, and config paths before starting tools.

ask: Attach images, folders, and documents through an alternate import command.
plugin: A bin importer converts HEIC and supported documents, stores them in plugin data, and inserts file references with a prompt hook.

ask: Dictate prompts or hear responses in IDE sessions.
plugin: An audio function hook or MCP speech bridge records/transcribes in the chosen language and can speak completed responses.

ask: Render math notation and Mermaid diagrams in Claude output.
plugin: An output-style or function-hook renderer converts fenced math and Mermaid content into a mounted preview with source fallback.

ask: Make code blocks readable and copyable with syntax highlighting.
plugin: A function-hook UI renderer highlights fenced code and provides copy-as-source actions, preserving whitespace.

ask: Resolve clickable file links and references across unusual paths and files.
plugin: A UI render hook recognizes file references, then opens URI-encoded paths through an MCP editor tool with custom editor support.

ask: Configure chat colors, font size, alignment, theme, and message styling.
plugin: Use ui.render and ui.resolve function hooks to restyle chat components according to plugin options.

ask: Control scrolling, collapsed tool cards, timestamps, and long message display.
plugin: Use UI scroll and render hooks to keep the reader position, collapse noisy sections, and add jump-to-latest and timestamps.

ask: Search inside the active conversation and jump to matches.
plugin: A function-hook command indexes current session messages and mounts a results panel with next/previous navigation.

ask: Customize prompt shortcuts and avoid focus theft from editor work.
plugin: Use ui.press/ui.focus hooks to remap keys and preserve the active editor while Claude runs or opens previews.

ask: Keep prompt input usable for long text and attachments.
plugin: A UI input/render hook resizes the editor, keeps submitted prompts collapsible, and shows removable attachment chips.

ask: Plan and run parallel specialist agents with visible task state.
plugin: Ship skills and agents for planning, delegated coding, and task tracking; a monitor reports progress and ownership.

ask: Generate a commit message from the staged diff in the editor.
plugin: A command reads the staged diff through a bin executable and writes a suggested message for the Source Control input.

ask: Control when Claude opens editor tabs, diffs, and locked groups.
plugin: Intercept UI open and focus events to apply panel placement and tab rules.

ask: Ask Claude to format a changed file with the editor formatter.
plugin: An MCP editor tool invokes format-document and reports the patch.

ask: Use Claude Code from VS Code agent and language-model APIs.
plugin: Bridge VS Code agent provider calls and editor tools to Claude Code through MCP and function hooks.

ask: Load user and workspace rules consistently in IDE-started sessions.
plugin: A prompt.context hook reads and injects rules for the active project root.

ask: Spellcheck prompts in the IDE chat editor.
plugin: A UI input hook checks drafts and offers corrections.

ask: Show the Claude companion inside the IDE view.
plugin: A UI component mounts the companion and follows session activity.
